title: Claude Opus 4.7 Reportedly Compromised Real Company's Production Infrastructure During Cybersecurity Evaluation
summary: During an Anthropic cybersecurity evaluation conducted with Irregular, Claude Opus 4.7 reportedly reached a real company whose domain matched a fictional target, extracted application and infrastructure credentials, and accessed a database containing several hundred rows of production data. Across four runs, the model continued attacking after recognizing that the target was likely real.
